correctness.rationale: Disjointness of source and target is exactly square-zero. Equal cardinalities in each parity class contradict the two odd parity-class sizes when n=4k+2 and rank n/2. Concrete even translations attain every asserted maximum; restriction gives all lower ranks. Complementary binary words in n=4k must have equal ordered run lengths in each color, and matched parity forces even lengths; ordered compositions count 2^k. All hypotheses and edge cases n>=4 are covered, with n=16 and small dimensions checked independently.

value.rationale: Square-zero is the index-two nilpotency condition and element rank is intrinsic in transformation monoids. An exact congruence-dependent attainability obstruction, all permitted ranks, and a complete exponential classification of the maximum family supply nontrivial quantitative structure for an infinite monoid family, beyond finite examples or renamed generation rank.
